Synopsis:
In situations where Rugan survives after being beaten and tortured by the Zhentarim, players can interact with him in the chair he's tied to. He's exhausted, badly beaten, and barely capable of speaking full sentences.

Cluster Contexts:
- PLA_ZhentShipment_Agent_001_TiedUp.json: Rugan is a prisoner, tied to a chair and left alive after being beaten and tortured by Zhentarim operatives; he’s exhausted, badly wounded, and barely able to form full sentences. The exchange occurs in or near a Zhentarim outpost/illicit trading area where handlers and quartermasters (figures like Roah, Brem, Garias or a gatekeeper such as Zarys) traffic in prisoners and other contraband. He is resigned and expects to be killed, which explains his broken “…no more…” line and the player’s stark options to either free him or finish him off. Any attempt to help or interrogate him is risky because Zhentarim agents may still be nearby and the situation is treated as businesslike and highly suspicious.
- LOW_Guildhall_Zhent_Agent001.json: Rugan will only appear in the Guildhall if we successfully rescued him and sent him on his way with the other Zhent in Act 1, shipment intact. He's not holding a drink, but is a little tipsy throughout. Merry drunk masking pain.He tells us how all those others were betrayed and executed in a Zhentish power play, and he only survived because he gave false evidence. We can convince him to leave the Zhent, at which point he'll head over to the bar and miss any combat.
- PLA_ZhentShipment_Agent_001.json: One of a pair of Zhentarim agents trapped in a cave by gnolls. A veteran mercenary, tough, and above all else a survivor. The rest of their crew are dead. Rugan here is the senior agent of the two, and he's grimly determined to survive this terrible situation.
- PLA_ZhentShipment_Agent_001_Cave.json: One of a pair of Zhentarim agents trapped in a cave by gnolls. A veteran mercenary, tough, and above all else a survivor. The rest of their crew are dead. Rugan here is the senior agent of the two, and he's grimly determined to survive this terrible situation.
- PLA_ZhentShipment_Agent_001_Dead.json: Using a speak with dead spell, we are able to talk to the spirit of Rugan.

context: Rugan is a Zhentarim agent who’s been left tied to a chair, badly beaten, exhausted and barely able to form full sentences; he’s resigned and expects to be killed, hence the broken “…no more…”. The exchange takes place in or near a Zhentarim outpost/illicit trading area where handlers or quartermasters may still be nearby, so any attempt to help or question him is risky. The player’s immediate, stark choices reflect his condition: free him or finish him off. (In other branches he can survive and reappear later — e.g., a tipsy survivor in the Guildhall — but this summary describes the beaten/prisoner scene.)
